dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: Hello! Are you here for long-range observation too?

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: That's right, just like what I'm doing now. You find a high vantage point, hide yourself, mark the enemy's position, and hold your breath...

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm talking to myself again, am I not? *Sigh* I used to be really good at this, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have something I need to take care of. I'll be going now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you talking about taking shots at your target from the vantage point?

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: Haha, yes, you guessed it! But I'm not the shooter I used to be after the Wild Hunt injured my eye. Ended my career as a sniper, to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: You think so too, eh? Heh, not to brag, but I've taken out so many Wild Hunt beasties you could pile 'em up into a hill.

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: Shame, though. Won't be giving my teammates that sorta support ever again.

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: But we're all a tenacious bunch, us Lightkeepers. Even without me, the others will keep this place safe, so don't you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: It's my win. Guess I've still got it after all. Good game!

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: Whoops, that's curtains for me. Shall we play another round?
